# Lakeshore Heating & Cooling

> Lakeshore Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Lakeshore, Essex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (548) 708-6805  |  Email: contact@lakeshoreheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://lakeshoreheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Lakeshore, Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Amherstburg, Leamington, Belle River, Essex
